student_solution: Assume without loss of generality that a>=b>=c. Then ab-c, ca-b, bc-a are powers of 2, so the smaller ones divide the larger ones. Hence ca-b = gcd(ab-c,ca-b). Now gcd(ab-c,ca-b) <= gcd(ab-c,c(a^2-1)). Since a^2-1 is odd, this gcd is at most c. Therefore ca-b <= c. Thus the only solution is (2,2,2).
